text.en:
The Divisoria Street, Ermita, City of Manila, shall hereafter be known as Romero Salas Street, in
memory of the illustrious Spanish journalist, Don Jose Maria Romero Salas.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, July 25, 1930.
